warnings: Fictional baseline traffic, costs, yields, network allocations and hidden net settlements; not observed operator accounts.
Map km are geodesic edge proxies; no literal inference of audited rail line length; zero mapped conventional km does not require zero conventional service cost.
No depreciation, financing, capital expenditure, subsidies, construction or investment response.
Taipei and Kaohsiung amounts are game-world CNY equivalent and hypothetical rail connectivity, not real-world company accounts.
Imported into V0.4 research model; native 96-seed replay is recorded separately in bureau_model/reports.

cost_calibration.currency: All baseline annual sums are 100 million CNY 2025 constant, same heuristic as current Southwest/South candidate
